rationale: Run060 already accepted 657 O members as current-session valid native inputs.
Early Run072 evidence shows independent Tencent volume disagreement would exclude a large fraction of those 657 despite valid native data.
The O model consumes frozen original-native volume, not Tencent volume; Tencent is an independent confirmation source.
Therefore independent session/OHLC remains a hard confirmation, while cross-provider volume deviation is diagnostic and must not by itself remove a Run060-valid member.
hard_checks: member belongs to official universe and is not one of the three base unresolved exclusions
Run060 native cache contains the member and exact target session
native history has at least 21 bars
target-session OHLC agrees within calibrated absolute tolerance
one_time_reconsideration_rule: A member excluded earlier in Run072 solely by the superseded volume hard gate may be reconsidered exactly once under this corrected contract. This is a systemic contract correction, not a bespoke symbol rescue. Any other member-local exclusion remains no-rescue.
